decisions.statement: A page is a domain by its page type rather than by the folder the page sits in.
Everything a domain carries could matter to every domain beneath that domain.
A domain is never weighed against how many domains there are.
A slug and a definition is a whole domain rather than a stub waiting to be filled in.
A domain stays even when nothing needs that domain any more.
A domain goes only when that domain no longer fits the structure.
Everything Alan wants done is a finding or an intent.
Context a choice does not need does not reach the agent making that choice.
Agents have the context each choice needs at the time those agents make that choice.
A seat's attributes represent the choices that seat will make.

directives.name: Alan Approves Directives
directives.act: Add a directive to a domain only where Alan has approved that directive.
directives.warrant: A directive binds every reader of a domain, and a wrong one is obeyed until noticed.
aids: Approving the initiative is not approving a directive.
A directive replacing an old one still needs approval.
A definition or a decision needs none.

directives.name: Single Authority
directives.act: Bind each claim from exactly one document.
directives.warrant: Where two documents bind one claim, their disagreement is a contradiction nothing can settle.
aids: Never summarise a claim another document binds.
Delete the old line when you move a claim.
